lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical or near-vertical line segments traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is tighter on the posterior flank (approx. 20-30 pixels) compared to the mid-section (approx. 40-50 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (neck/shoulder) is abbreviated, terminating at the mid-neck line. Line 7 (mid-flank) is dashed and terminates before the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular spots located on the posterior flank above the hind limb junction.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Simple lyrate trajectory with a posterior-dorsal orientation, approximately 40 degrees from the vertical axis of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: 3.2:1 (Estimated pixel distance between terminal tips relative to the pixel width of the horn bases).
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: 0.15 (High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total vertical horn length).

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron marker on the bridge of the snout; white spots on the cheek below the ocular region; distinct white patch at the base of the throat.
